mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zentide_change WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND verification_status='VERIFIED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_user_action(user_id,change_id,action_type,action_value,status) VALUES(#{userId},#{changeId},'WATCH',#{watchMode},'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE action_value=VALUES(action_value),status='ACTIVE',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_user_action SET status='STOPPED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND action_type='WATCH' AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT c.*,w.action_value AS watch_mode,w.updated_at AS watched_at FROM zentide_user_action w JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=w.change_id WHERE w.user_id=#{userId} AND w.action_type='WATCH' AND w.status='ACTIVE' AND c.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
